draft_reason: immediate infra files mix desired state, projections, and adapter policy during topology cleanup.
promotion_condition: infra surfaces have stable owners, projection rendering is covered by validation, and registry/agent exposure contracts remain mechanically green.
purpose: Classify immediate infra/* files so organism-wide desired state and agent policy surfaces stay explicit.

canonical.rule: Canonical infra surfaces are durable source-of-truth files and may be mutated only through contract-aware review.
canonical.exit_condition: remain canonical while validation covers their authority; demote only if ownership moves to another contract

canonical_partial.rule: Canonical partial infra surfaces are intended source of truth but still have open membrane, projection, or validation debt.
canonical_partial.exit_condition: promote to canonical after membrane closure and executable validation cover their role

projection.rule: Projection infra surfaces mirror or render another authority and must not be edited as independent truth.
projection.exit_condition: keep generated and validated, promote to canonical only with explicit authority, or delete

quarantined.rule: Quarantined infra surfaces are excluded from active desired state.
quarantined.exit_condition: delete, archive as evidence, or reclassify after authority is explicit

transitional.rule: Transitional infra surfaces are temporary during topology cleanup.
transitional.exit_condition: promote, project, quarantine, or delete after next_action is complete
